newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta shares close higher after hitting record.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta shares close higher after hitting record.

text.p: Strong overseas buying on some blue-chips helped Jakarta share prices to close higher on Wednesday after earlier hitting a record of 700.89 points, brokers said.

The Jakarta Composite Index rose 6.78 points, or 0.98 percent, to close at 701.06 points as gainers led losers by 71 to 46, with 44 counters unchanged. Total volume was 170.3 million shares on a volume of 508.1 billion rupiah.
"I believe the market will continue to be upbeat tomorrow following the sustained foreign buying interest," a broker with a foreign firm said.

Banking stocks were likely to continue drawing market attention on Thursday because of a general perception the sector might post better 1997 earnings with possibility of further interest rate cuts, brokers said.
Brokers attributed the rise on Wednesday to market talk that an American securities house in the region had revised its buying programme.

"The news is not new at all. As predicted, some securities companies are selling their stakes in Hongkong and switching to other countries in the region ahead of the Chinese take-over of Hongkong," a broker with Japanese-firm said.
Blue-chip Indosat and Telkom were actively traded on its fundamental aspects.
Indosat rose 225 rupiah to 6,975 rupiah on a volume of 3.1 million shares, incited by its better-than-expected 1996 results.
Telkom rose slightly by 25 rupiah to 4,225 rupiah on 4.9 million shares on an expectation its 1996 result would be encouraging.
Heavyweight Bank Negara Indonesia topped the active list with 16.5 million shares traded, rising 50 rupiah to 1,700 rupiah.
